findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the only hand sink in the kitchen to be obstructed with a pitcher and box of single-service items. The staff were informed that hand sinks must be accessible at all times of food preparation and service. The sink was cleared during the inspection. Ensure this sink remains available at all times to incentivize staff to wash hands regularly.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a bag of hot dogs in the chest cooler to not be date marked. Discussed with PIC, and PIC date marked the bag of hot dogs. Ensure opened food items are date marked within 24 hours of opening and kept for only 7 days thereafter.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17(B) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. (B) Except as specified in (E) - (G) of this section, refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and PACKAGED by a FOOD PROCESSING PLANT shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and if the FOOD is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded, based on the temperature and time combinations specified in (A) of this section and: (1) The day the original container is opened in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be counted as Day 1; and (2) The day or date marked by the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT may not exceed a manufacturer’s use-by date if the manufacturer determined the use-by date based on FOOD safety.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Upon inspector arrival, a watering can was being held in the hand washing sink.  Discussed with PIC and employees.  Ensure the hand washing sink is not used for anything other than handwashing.

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The caulk along the 3 part sink is cracked and coming apart along most of the surface.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure sink is recaulked to create a smooth, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text:
750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

New FDA food code states a certified food protection manager must be on site during all hours of food prep/operation. Discussed requirement with person in charge.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14  (Pf) Test kits or other devices are not available to the employees to measure sanitizing solution concentration. Provide a test kit or other measuring device so the employees can measure concentrations and ensure proper sanitization. Avoid a concentration of sanitizer that is too high, which can be toxic. Reference 4-302.14.

No test strips available to test concentration of sanitizer in 3 compartment sink. Discussed with person in charge. She is purchasing new strips.
